**[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
***[[2024 Beqaa Valley airstrikes]]

*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] announces the expedited granting of more than US$6 billion in [[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|military aid to Ukraine]] prior to [[President-elect of the United States|president-elect]] [[Donald Trump]]'s [[Second inauguration of Donald Trump|inauguration in January]]. '''Business and economy'''
*The [[Institute of International Finance]] cautions that if [[United States|U.S.]] [[President-elect of the United States|president-elect]] [[Donald Trump]] follows through with [[Second Trump tariffs|the tariffs that he campaigned on]], this will result in a renewal of [[inflation]] and higher [[Banking in the United States|U.S. banking loan]] [[interest rate]]s. [https://www.cnbc.com/2024/10/23/trump-tariffs-likely-to-lead-to-higher-us-interest-rates-iif-chief.html (CNBC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Rafael (2024)|Hurricane Rafael]] approaches the southern coast of [[Cuba]] as a [[Saffir–Simpson scale|Category 3 hurricane]], triggering mass evacuations amid warnings of life-threatening [[flash flood]]ing and [[storm surge]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/hurricane-rafael-strengthening-quickly-it-churns-north-towards-cuba-2024-11-06/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 California wildfires]]
**Amid extreme fire weather conditions and a [[particularly dangerous situation]] [[red flag warning]], the [[Mountain Fire (2024)|Mountain Fire]] in [[Ventura County, California|Ventura County]], [[California]], [[United States|U.S.]], develops and grows to {{convert|10400|acre|km2|0}} in less than eight hours. [https://www.cbsnews.com/losangeles/news/mountain-fire-in-moorpark-fueled-by-strong-winds-amid-red-flag-warnings/ (CBS News)]
*A [[Honda HA-420 HondaJet]] crashes into a vehicle during take off from [[Falcon Field (Arizona)|Falcon Field]] in [[Mesa, Arizona]], U.S., killing five people. [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/jet-crash-mesa-arizona-5-killed-falcon-field-airport/ (CBS News)]
*Forty-three [[Rhesus macaque]] monkeys escape from the Alpha Genesis, Inc. research facility in [[Yemassee, South Carolina|Yemassee]], [[South Carolina]], [[United States]] after an enclosure is improperly fastened. [https://apnews.com/article/monkeys-escape-alpha-genesis-south-carolina-66a78279a7abe57c5f8fd0953359368a/ (Associated Press)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Protests against Donald Trump]]
**[[Just Stop Oil]] protesters spray orange paint on the outside of the [[Embassy of the United States, London|American Embassy]] in [[London]], [[United Kingdom]], following [[Donald Trump]]'s re-election in the [[2024 United States presidential election|2024 U.S. presidential election]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/us-embassy-just-stop-oil-trump-election-paint-b2642378.html (''The Independent'')]
**[[United States|U.S.]] protesters gather in [[San Jose, California|San Jose]], [[Berkeley, California|Berkeley]], [[Chicago]], [[Philadelphia]], and [[New York City]] to [[Protests against the second presidency of Donald Trump|protest]] following the re-election of Donald Trump. [https://www.mercurynews.com/2024/11/06/anti-trump-protestors-gather-in-san-jose-berkeley (''Mercury News'')] [https://www.newsweek.com/donald-trump-protests-cities-1981841 (''Newsweek'')]
*[[Human trafficking in Greece]]
**Four people are killed and 25 others are rescued after [[Human trafficking|human traffickers]] force them from their boat into the water off the coast of [[Rhodes]], [[Greece]], and abandon them. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/6/four-die-in-greece-after-smuggler-allegedly-forces-passengers-off-boat (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 United States elections|2024 U.S. elections]]
**[[2024 United States presidential election|2024 U.S. presidential election]], [[Second presidency of Donald Trump]]
***[[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] candidates [[First presidency of Donald Trump|45th]] U.S. president [[Donald Trump]] and [[United State Senate|U.S. Senator]] [[JD Vance]] are elected as the 47th [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] and 50th [[Vice President of the United States|U.S. Vice President]] respectively. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/elections/2024/11/05/election-live-updates-trump-harris/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://apnews.com/article/election-day-trump-harris-white-house-83c8e246ab97f5b97be45cdc156af4e2 (AP)]
****Trump will become the first person since [[Grover Cleveland]] in [[1892 United States presidential election|1892]] to serve non-consecutive presidential terms, as well as the oldest presidential candidate and first [[Prosecution of Donald Trump in New York|convicted]] [[felony|felon]] to be elected president. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cj0jr5ypqedo (BBC News)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/11/06/us/politics/trump-wins-presidency.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://apnews.com/article/grover-cleveland-president-nonconsecutive-terms-7ea2c92c72911462ccb1bc2e7352fa23 (AP)]
****Vance is the first [[millennial]] to be elected U.S. Vice President. [https://www.dw.com/en/who-is-vice-president-elect-jd-vance-trumps-heir-apparent/a-70708624 (DW)]
**[[2024 United States Senate elections|2024 U.S. Senate elections]]
***The Republican Party wins a majority in the [[United States Senate|U.S. Senate]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/control-us-congress-stake-tight-election-battle-2024-11-05/ (Reuters)] [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2024/nov/06/senate-elections-republicans-win (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Second presidential transition of Donald Trump]]
***U.S. Vice President and [[Kamala Harris 2024 presidential campaign|Democratic Party]] candidate [[Kamala Harris]] [[Concession (politics)|concedes]] defeat to Donald Trump in a speech at [[Howard University]] in [[Washington, D.C.]], stating that she and U.S. President [[Joe Biden]] will commit to a [[peaceful transition of power]]. [https://time.com/7173622/kamala-harris-concession-speech-election/ (''Time'')]
*[[2024 German government crisis]]
**In [[Germany]], the [[Scholz cabinet]] loses its majority following the dismissal of [[Federal Ministry of Finance (Germany)|finance minister]] [[Christian Lindner]] and the resignation of all remaining [[Free Democratic Party (Germany)|Free Democratic Party]] members. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/german-chancellor-scholz-sacks-finance-minister-over-budget-dispute-sources-say-2024-11-06/ (Reuters)]
